Farmers selling produce in value added from (Off farm value addition) increased by 38% in FY 2023/24 and 53% to date. The calculation was based on farmers collective marketing .e.g. FPOs, increase .
The Nov 2025 progress is a provisional estimation based on baseline and MTR survey.

title.narrative: No of Agripreneurs fully developed and paired to support county teams

comment.narrative: This is the number of youth/women identified, trained, mentored and graduated to offer bundled services at county level. The project recruited 7,525 Agripreneurs i.e. 7 agriprenuers per ward in 1,075 project's wards. Due to natural attrition the recruited AP declined. The AP development is on-going with bootcamp completed, in readiness for incubation and commercialization. The project targets to develop 5 APs per Ward in 1,075 project Wards
